NXRT15XH103FA1B010




            Appearance & Shape                                                                                                     Features

                                                                                                                     1. High accuracy and high sensibility temperature sensing is
                                                                                                                     available by the high accuracy NTC Thermistor.
                                                                                                                     2. This product is compatible with 1005 (1.0mm * 0.5mm) size
                                                                                                                     NTC Thermistor.
                                                                                                                     3. The variation per hour of this product is stable few.
                                                                                                                     4. This product is produced with the automation line which was
                                                                                                                     consistent from a lead to packing so that the product of uniform
                                                                                                                     quality may be obtained at low cost in large quantities.
                                                                                                                     5. Since this product has strong lead intensity with original lead
                                                                                                                     mounting technique, it is bent at the time of use and can perform
                                                                                                                     processing etc. freely. Moreover, taping supply can also respond.
                                                                                                                     6. UL/cULcertified product.(UL1434, File No. E137188)
